name: read_media_part_data_url
doc: `readMediaPartDataUrl`: the data URL of an image part. EMF and WMF go through the host's converter, TIFF through its re-encoder.

name: media_part_data_url
doc: `mediaPartDataUrl`: one string per media part, so a picture anchored on thousands of paragraphs does not hold thousands of base64 copies.

name: media_data_url
doc: `mediaDataUrl`: an image relationship id as a data URL (embedded parts only); `source_path` is the part that owns the relationship.

name: resolve_pic_bullets

name: push_unique

name: source_path_of

name: resolve_blip_media
doc: `resolveBlipMedia`: a paragraph's blip and VML imagedata rIds into `ctx.mediaByRid`, so extractRuns can build image runs.

name: extract_image
doc: `extractImage`: the picture of an a:blip as a data URL, or the target of a linked one.

name: rel_part_path
doc: `relPartPath`: the part a document relationship names, `None` (null) for an external or missing one.

name: rel_part_path_of
doc: `relPartPath(ctx, rId)`

name: extract_chart

name: capture

name: ole_display
doc: `oleDisplay`: the preview picture (v:imagedata) and ProgID of an OLE embed, and the declared size and alignment of the object. A `Block` with the keys `imageDataUrl`, `oleProgId`, `imageWidthPx`, `imageHeightPx` and `imageAlign` only.

name: aligned_picture_x_emu
doc: `alignedPictureXEmu`: the column-relative X (EMU) of a `wp:align` positioned anchor (no posOffset): left/center/right (inside/outside read as left/right) within the column, margin box or paper.

name: picture_column_geom
doc: `pictureColumnGeom`: the column-relative X extent (EMU) of a side-wrapped anchored picture in a single-column section.

name: picture_beside_float_table
doc: `pictureBesideFloatTable`: a side-wrapped picture sharing its anchor paragraph's column with a floating table, when the widest remaining gap is a sliver no text fits beside them, so Word resumes the text below both.

name: picture_overhangs_column
doc: `pictureOverhangsColumn`: a picture reaching past a column edge with no text room left beside it (cover art pinned to the paper); a CSS float would cap it at the column, so it takes the band route and keeps its extent.

name: txbx_para_visible
doc: `txbxParaVisible`: a paragraph the box shows, text runs or a table row.

name: rel_h
doc: `anchorRelH` as the model's value.

name: rel_v
doc: `anchorRelV` as the model's value.

name: read_anchor_pos
doc: `readAnchorPos`: wp:anchor wp:positionH/V of a header/footer image. wp:align keeps the alignment fields, wp:posOffset (EMU) becomes a px offset from the band `anchorRelH`/`anchorRelV` name.

name: read_body_pr
doc: `readBodyPr`: wps:bodyPr insets (EMU) and vertical anchor of a DrawingML textbox.

name: rect_frac
doc: `rectFrac`: an a:srcRect / a:fillRect attribute (1000ths of a percent; some writers emit decimals) as a fraction. `name` goes into the pattern unescaped, as in the original.

name: pic_border_of
doc: `picBorderOf`: the picture outline (an a:ln with a solid fill on the pic's own spPr). A theme-coloured outline is left out.

name: first_node
doc: `first` of `groupPictureLayers`: the first node named `name` at or below `root`, in document order.

name: group_picture_layers
doc: `groupPictureLayers`: a wpg group made only of pictures, each mapped through the group transform into fractions of the wp:extent box, bottom first. `None` (null) for a group with shapes, nesting or turned pictures.

name: pic_transform_of
doc: `picTransformOf`: rotation and flips on the pic's own xfrm (an anchored textbox sibling has its own wps xfrm).

name: attr_num

name: emu_px
doc: `px` of `hfShapeDrawingSvg`: EMU as px rounded to 1/100.

name: place_path
doc: `placePath` of `hfShapeDrawingSvg`: normalized 0..1 path tokens as a px path inside the shape's rect.

name: hf_shape_drawing_svg
doc: `hfShapeDrawingSvg`: textless vector decoration in a header/footer drawing (a wpg group of solid-fill custGeom wps shapes) composed into one SVG data URL at the wp:extent size. `None` (null) on any piece it cannot draw: rotation, flips, text, a missing fill or geometry.

name: parse_compatibility_mode
doc: `parseCompatibilityMode`: the compatSetting compatibilityMode of settings.xml, 0 when absent (legacy layout).

name: flag
doc: `xmlFlagOn` over a tag literal, whose pattern always compiles.

name: parse_layout_settings
doc: `parseLayoutSettings`: w:autoHyphenation, w:defaultTabStop (absent is Word's 720 twips) and the compatibility flags of settings.xml the layout reads.

name: model_note_props
doc: The model's `NoteProps` of what `notePropsFromXml` read, its keys set in the order of its literal.

name: parse_note_props
doc: `parseNoteProps`: the document-wide footnotePr / endnotePr, settings.xml overlaid by the final body sectPr (`{ ...base, ...own }`).

name: parse_settings_flag
doc: `parseSettingsFlag`: an on/off flag of settings.xml such as `<w:evenAndOddHeaders/>` (w:val="0|false" is off). `tag` goes into a pattern unescaped, as in the original.

name: parse_sources
doc: `parseSources`

name: read_theme_font_lang
doc: `readThemeFontLang`: w:themeFontLang w:eastAsia / w:bidi of settings.xml.

name: txbx_content_paras
doc: `txbxContentParas`: the paragraphs (and tables, one display line per row) of a w:txbxContent node. `doc_offset` is the host paragraph's document.xml offset (section grid for character indents).

name: collect_txbx_paras
doc: `collectTxbxParas`

name: txbx_table_paras
doc: `txbxTableParas`: a table inside a textbox: the same layout-table rows as a header/footer table (cell columns from tblGrid / tcW, per-cell borders, margins, shading), one display paragraph per row. Nested tables flatten into their host cell.

name: paragraph_stray_box
doc: `paragraphStrayBox`: a display-only line for text a paragraph carries alongside its VML shapes (canvas + trailing hyperlinks): the shape XML is stripped and the remaining runs rendered as a boxless read-only paragraph, so the text stays visible.

name: engine_section_of
doc: The geometry of a model section as the engine's `SectionSettings` the anchor readers of `drawing_geometry` take; they read page size, margins and columns only.

name: or_zero

name: int_attr

name: column_width_emu
doc: The usable column width of a section, in EMU.

name: extract_textboxes
doc: `extractTextboxes`: the display boxes of a paragraph's drawings.

name: pinnable
doc: `pinnable`: first-page cover art with a page-relative V anchor keeps RAW page coordinates and pins to the page box itself.

name: pin_all
doc: All-or-nothing per paragraph: the un-positioned pagepinned wrapper would break any sibling drawing still positioned from the paragraph origin.

name: fix_up_metas
doc: Page-relative posOffset measures from the page edge; boxes render from the column/paragraph origin, so keeping the raw value double-counts the margins (X is exact; Y approximates the anchor paragraph at body top, strictly closer than the raw page offset). One pass up front keeps every consumer in the same column space; pinned metas keep raw page coordinates.

name: anchor_union_spans_column
doc: `anchorUnionSpansColumn`: the union of the paragraph's anchored drawing extents; when the widest remaining horizontal gap in the column is a sliver, no text fits beside the boxes and Word lays it above/below the row.

name: apply_anchor
doc: `applyAnchor`: placement and wrap of a box from its drawing's anchor.

name: extent_px_pair
doc: `extentTag`'s `cx`/`cy` of a drawing's wp:extent tag.

name: picture_box
doc: The picture box skeleton: read-only, inkless insets.

name: media_of
doc: `ctx.mediaByRid?.get(rId)`, an empty URL being no URL.

name: fragment
doc: One top-level drawing fragment of the paragraph.

name: walk_shapes
doc: `walkShapes`: a document-order walk (box order must match w:txbxContent order for the patch-save mapping), carrying the enclosing wpg group transform and fill; anything below a wps:wsp lives inside its txbx and is nested.

name: push_shape
doc: `pushShape`

name: push_pic
doc: `pushPic`: a grouped pic:pic (photo inside a wpg group) as a photo box at the mapped child offset, painted in document order between its sibling shapes.

name: round_hundredths

name: build_wps_box

name: attrs_record

name: vml_shape_type_attrs
doc: `vmlShapeTypeAttrs(type)`: the attributes of the v:shapetype a shape's `type="#id"` names, in the paragraph or document-wide.

name: place_vml_box
doc: `placeVmlBox`: top-level absolute shapes float at their pt margins; group children float at the group origin plus scaled group coordinates.

name: vml_pic_box
doc: `vmlPicBox`: a VML picture shape (v:imagedata with an r:id) as a photo box, like the DrawingML pushPic path: dropping it loses real page content.

name: vml_geom_box
doc: `vmlGeomBox`: textless VML geometry with a visible fill or stroke (callout tabs, path-drawn table backdrops): rendered, not silently dropped.

name: vml_box
doc: `vmlBox`: children of a v:group (drawing canvas) position and size in the group's own coordinate space (unitless style values); the scale maps them to px.

name: walk_vml
doc: `walkVml`

name: vml_hr_rule
doc: `vmlHrRule`: the stroke of a VML horizontal rule (`<v:rect o:hr="t">` opening tag). A width of 0 means "fill the available width".

name: has_floating_vml_geometry
doc: `hasFloatingVmlGeometry`: a textless top-level v:shape/rect/roundrect/oval placed with position:absolute.

name: vml_picts_inline_only
doc: `vmlPictsInlineOnly`: every w:pict of the paragraph either draws nothing (no shape instance) or is an inline shape the SVG path can render.

name: vml_flag_off

name: vml_stroke_weight_px
doc: `vmlStrokeWeightPx`: v:shape strokeweight ("0.75pt", "2px", bare = pt) as CSS px.

doc: `applyVmlMsoPosition`: Word's VML placement of a top-level absolute shape. mso-position-horizontal keywords resolve against the column, margin or page box (relative "text", the default, is the column), and page/margin-relative numeric offsets become page positions.

name: vml_length_px
doc: `vmlLengthPx` of parse.ts: a VML CSS length in px, pt / in / cm / mm / px / pc, unitless = pt (Word writes a bare 0), rounded to 1/100 px. Not the `vmlLengthPx` of parse-vml.ts (`crate::vml::vml_length_px`).

doc: `vmlImageMeta`: VML picture geometry (v:shape style) as the DrawingML image fields of a block: size, absolute offsets, behind-text z-index and margin- or page-relative keyword placement.

name: vml_stroke_child_off
doc: `vmlStrokeChildOff`: a v:stroke child that switches the stroke off.

name: has_deep_child
doc: `hasDeepChild`: depth-first search for any descendant with one of the given names.

name: has_floating_vml_picture
doc: `hasFloatingVmlPicture`: any descendant floating VML picture shape (watermarks), drawn at its anchor and never in the flow. Textbox shapes are excluded: their own content decides.

doc: `Number(attrsOf(findChild(node ?? {}, name) ?? {})[key])`

doc: `!type || type === 'dxa'`

doc: `!(x > 0)`: true for NaN too.

name: tcw_column_widths
doc: `tcwColumnWidths`: per-column widths reconstructed from cell `w:tcW` (dxa) across all rows: the widest un-spanned cell per grid slot wins (Word widens a column to fit later rows, never narrows it). `None` unless every column got a value: partial data would skew the ratio worse than the tblGrid fallback.

name: table_prop_exceptions_of
doc: `tablePropExceptionsOf`

name: apply_row_prop_exceptions
doc: `applyRowPropExceptions`: Word draws a row's `w:tblPrEx` borders/margins/shading in place of the table-level ones: resolved onto the row's cells (explicit tcPr stays on top, the table style below). Outer sides map to the table edge, inner ones to insideH/insideV.

name: apply_table_style_display
doc: `applyTableStyleDisplay`: layers the referenced table style's fills / first-row formatting under the cells' explicit properties, honoring the `w:tblLook` flags. Display-only: untouched tables still save byte-identically.

name: attach_raw_table_pr
doc: `attachRawTablePr`: attaches each cell's rawTcPr and each row's rawTrPr from the original table XML (byte fidelity: surgically patched on regeneration so unmodeled tcMar/textDirection/tblHeader etc. are not lost). Uses depth-aware `splitXmlChildren` so nested tables do not misalign; gives up when row/column counts disagree with the parse result (conservative: never attach to the wrong cell).

name: js_slice_from
doc: `text.slice(from, to)` where `to` may be `lastIndexOf`'s -1 (no match): `slice(from, -1)` stops one unit short of the end.

name: extract_table
doc: `extractTable`: display-only table structure. Nested tables render as read-only sub-tables inside their cell; the exact original bytes are what get saved, so lossiness here only affects on-screen rendering.  `doc_offset` is the table's document.xml offset: cell paragraphs resolve their character-unit indents under that section's document grid.  The TypeScript wraps the whole read in a `try`, so a table it cannot build (hostile depth inside a cell paragraph) degrades to `None`, not a failed document: so does every refusal here.

name: attr_number
doc: `Number(attrsOf(node)[key])` of an optional attribute

name: extract_table_model
doc: `extractTableModel`: one `w:tbl` node to the display model (shared by top-level tables and tables nested in cells).

name: extract_cell
doc: `extractCell`: one `w:tc` to its display cell: properties, paragraphs with their runs, nested tables and anchored boxes.

name: hf_movable_picture_frag
doc: `hfMovablePictureFrag`: a `<w:drawing>` fragment the strip can move and resize, one floating picture with its own extents.

name: anchor_doc_pr_ids
doc: `anchorDocPrIds`: the `wp:docPr` ids of the anchored drawings below `node`.

name: has_deep_child_outside
doc: `hasDeepChildOutside`: a descendant named one of `names`, not looking into the subtrees named one of `skip`.

name: hf_part_info
doc: `hfPartInfo`: what the model keeps of a header or footer part; no `images` key where it has none.

name: bind_hf_image_anchors
doc: `bindHfImageAnchors`: each image whose anchor id (`image_anchor_ids`, the `hfImageAnchorId` of each image) a strip row holds (`row_anchor_ids`, the `hfRowAnchorIds` of each paragraph) is bound to the first such row.

name: strip_hf_deletions
doc: `stripHfDeletions`: tracked deletions and moves away of drawings leave the part; deleted text stays.

name: hf_tbl_ranges
doc: `hfTblRanges`: the `[start, end)` UTF-16 spans of the top-level `w:tbl` elements of a part.

name: hf_tbl_ranges_bytes
doc: `hfTblRanges` as byte offsets of `xml`, which is what the readers of a part compare match indexes with.

name: byte_at_unit
doc: The byte offset of `text.slice(0, end)`: `end` in UTF-16 units, truncated and clamped to the text. An end inside a surrogate pair stops before it.

name: hf_cell_column_left_px
doc: `hfCellColumnLeftPx`: px from the margin to the text column of the table cell holding UTF-16 offset `at`: `w:tblInd` plus the grid columns of the cells before it in its row.

name: hf_cell_column_left_px_at
doc: `hfCellColumnLeftPx` for an `at` that is a byte offset of `xml` (a match index, as the readers of a part count).

name: cell_column_left_px
doc: The body of `hfCellColumnLeftPx`: `before` says whether the byte offset of a tag lies before `at`, `at_byte` is `at` as a byte offset.

name: hf_only_empty_runs
doc: `hfOnlyEmptyRuns`: the paragraph holds nothing but its `w:pPr` and runs with nothing but their `w:rPr`.

name: hf_line
doc: `hfLine`: a border that draws a line.

name: hf_table_float_of
doc: `hfTableFloatOf`: the `w:tblpPr` of a header or footer layout table; `None` where the table is in the flow.

name: without_resolved_geometry
doc: `withoutResolvedGeometry`: the direct paragraph format without the keys the resolver settles through the style chain.

name: parse_field_tree
doc: `parseFieldTree`: the complex fields of a part, as a tree. A field's span runs from its begin to the end that closes it, counting the nested fields, so a child's end does not close the parent (genoffice#2458). Each field carries only its own instruction text: a nested child's instruction belongs to the child.

name: js_slice
doc: `xml.slice(from, to)` for offsets that may be -1 (a field that was not closed): a negative offset counts from the end.

name: render_field_region
doc: `renderFieldRegion`: a region of the part with the fields inside it rewritten: every nested field is replaced by its display text.

name: without_fld_chars
doc: `/<w:fldChar[^>]*?(?:\/>|>[\s\S]*?<\/w:fldChar>)/g` replaced by nothing.

name: render_field
doc: `renderField`: the display text of one field: a page-number marker for a PAGE/NUMPAGES field, its cached result for anything else. A field's instruction is field code and never displays, so the nested fields inside it drop out with it: only the ones inside the cached result are rewritten.

name: last_index_of
doc: `text.lastIndexOf(search, from)`: the last occurrence that starts at or before byte `from`.

name: first_capture
doc: `m.index` of the first capture group named by a regex over `frag`.

name: positive
doc: `Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0`

name: wrap_of
doc: The wrapping a `wp:wrapNone` ... `wp:wrapTopAndBottom` element names.

name: crop_of
doc: `{ l: rectFrac(srcRect, 'l'), t, r, b }` kept when any side is truthy.

name: dist_px
doc: `Math.round(Number(new RegExp(`\\b${attr}="(\\d+)"`).exec(anchorTag)?.[1] ?? 0) / EMU_PER_PX)`

name: doc_pr_id
doc: The `wp:docPr` id of a fragment: `/<wp:docPr\s[^>]*\bid="([^"]+)"/`.

name: fallback_dup
doc: true = skip this match (its Choice sibling already produced an image)

name: float_anchor
doc: `vmlFloatAnchor(style, image)` on an `HfImage`: the keys the VML anchor reads are set on the image, after the keys it has.

name: hf_group_pictures
doc: `hfGroupPictures`: an anchored wpg group of pictures (logo strips): one `HfImage` per child picture at its own mapped offset, size and a:srcRect crop. `None` (the caller falls back to the single-image path) unless the anchor uses posOffset on both axes and every child picture has a plain xfrm.

name: hf_images
doc: `hfImages`: the display-only images of a header/footer part (logos etc.): resolves `a:blip r:embed` and VML `v:imagedata r:id` from the part's own rels; watermarks (`v:textpath`) are read as watermark shapes. The save path does not go through here: image paragraphs keep their original bytes when the part is regenerated.  `run_image_ids` is `hfRunImageIds.get(paras)`: the `wp:docPr` ids of the inline pictures the part's text paragraphs keep on their runs.

name: hf_table_media
doc: `hfTableMedia`: the pre-resolved image media (rId to data/external URL) for pictures inside a header/footer part's layout tables, so the sync cell-run extraction can attach them (mirrors `tableBlipMedia`).

name: read_part
doc: Reads a part of the package as text (`await file.async('string')`).

name: number
doc: `Number(attrsOf(node)[key])`

name: hf_para_style_layers
doc: `hfParaStyleLayers`: the direct format of a strip paragraph and the display of its paragraph style: Word's built-in Header/Footer styles carry the center/right tab stops (and sometimes w:jc); direct pPr wins per property.

name: hf_empty_mark_font
doc: `hfEmptyMarkFont`: the face sizing an empty strip paragraph's line. Word lays the mark with its East Asian font only under w:hint="eastAsia" AND an East Asian w:lang; otherwise the Latin font. Decided only for hinted marks and marks whose two slots name one face; other marks keep the strip's document line factor.

name: hf_styled_para_format
doc: `hfStyledParaFormat`: the display format of a strip paragraph: the direct pPr with the geometry the resolver settles through the style chain, docDefaults and compat (spacing, line, alignment, indents, borders) laid over it.

name: no_border
doc: `NO_BORDER`

name: covering
doc: The cell of `row` covering grid column `col`.

name: hf_cell_borders

doc: `parseGroup`: a `{...}` group or, as LaTeX reads an argument, exactly one token.

name: brace_text
doc: `readBraceText`: the raw text of a `{...}` group.

name: sequence
doc: `parseSequence`: atoms until `stop`, a `^` or `_` script applied to the atom before it.

name: atom
doc: `parseAtom`: a control sequence, a group, or a run of ordinary characters.

name: read_delimiter
doc: `readDelimiter`: the token after `\left` or `\right`.

name: control
doc: `parseControl`: the control sequence after a backslash.

name: omml_to_mathml
doc: `ommlToMathML`: MathML Core for one or more `<m:oMath>` fragments, which may come concatenated; `""` where nothing converts.

name: mml_slot
doc: `mmlSlot`: an `m:e`, `m:num`... container as an `mrow`.

name: run_text_to_mml
doc: `runTextToMml`: a text run as `mn`, `mi`, `mo` and `mtext` tokens.

name: omml_to_latex
doc: `ommlToLatex`: one `<m:oMath>` fragment as LaTeX, or `None` (`null`) where there is not exactly one fragment, it does not parse, or it holds a structure outside the subset.

name: latex_slot
doc: `latexSlot`: an `m:e`, `m:num`... container, `""` where it is absent.

name: matrix_body
doc: `matrixBody`: the rows of an `m:m` or `m:eqArr` as `a & b \\ c & d`.

name: delim_token
doc: `delimTokens`: the `\left`/`\right` token of a delimiter character, `.` for none.

name: plain_text_of_runs
doc: `plainTextOfRuns`: the `m:t` text of the `m:r` children, for function names and `lim`.

name: chars_to_latex
doc: `charsToLatex`: ordinary math text, syntax characters escaped and symbols as their commands.

name: value_of
doc: `table[key]` for a key the table owns.

name: first_key_of
doc: The first key whose value is `value`: the inverse maps of math.ts.

name: escape_xml
doc: `escapeXmlText`, and with `attribute` `escapeXmlAttr`: drops the control characters XML 1.0 forbids, escapes `&`, `<`, `>` and for an attribute `"`. A duplicate of the escaping inside `ooxml_xml::serialize`, which that crate does not export.

name: content_children
doc: `contentChildren`: child elements that are content, not `m:*Pr` property bags or text between elements.

name: prop_val
doc: `propVal`: the `m:val` of `childName` inside the property bag `prName`.

name: prop_on
doc: `propOn`: present and not `0`, `false` or `off` in any case.

name: run_is_plain
doc: Whether a run is upright text: `m:sty="p"` or an `m:nor` in its `m:rPr`.

name: assert_declared_sizes_within_limits
doc: The part-count, per-part and total declared-size gate. Advisory only: it costs nothing when the archive tells the truth and holds nothing when it lies. `assert_zip_inflates_within_limits` is the gate that holds.

name: assert_zip_inflates_within_limits
doc: The gate that holds against a forged central directory: inflating one byte past what a part claims catches a liar at `declared + 1` bytes, and an oversized declaration is rejected before anything is inflated.

name: at
doc: Little-endian read of two or four bytes the caller has bounds-checked.

name: scan_parts
doc: Reads the central directory. Only the fields the gate uses are read, and every offset is bounds-checked against the file before it is touched.

name: verified_size
doc: The part's real length, refusing to inflate past what it declared.

name: inflate_raw_bounded
doc: Inflates and stops at the claim, so the payload is never held.  The TypeScript gate reads a `DecompressionStream`: input goes in 64 KiB slices, output comes out as the inflater fills a 16 KiB buffer, and a failing call delivers nothing. A part that both lies about its size and is damaged is refused for whichever shows first in those steps, so the steps are the same here.  Data after the end of the deflate stream is refused, as the Compression Streams standard has it and as the product's hosts do (Chromium); the gate's own host, Node 22, ignores it, which is a listed divergence. What the stream held is counted against the claim first.

name: under_declared
doc: Claims less than the bytes deliver: that gap is exactly where bombs live.

name: read_int
doc: `readInt`: `result = (result << 8) + byte`, where `<<` wraps to 32 bits and `+` does not.

name: read_data
doc: `readData`. A negative size passes the check when the index stays in range: it reads nothing and moves the index back.

name: pretty
doc: `utils.pretty`: every byte as `\xNN`.

name: crc32
doc: The CRC-32 of JSZip's crc32.js, as the signed number it returns.

name: file_name_str
doc: `handleUTF8`: the name as a string. The comment is decoded there too, and its Unicode extra field can end the load with an error.

name: unicode_extra_field
doc: `findExtraFieldUnicodePath` and `findExtraFieldUnicodeComment`: the Info-ZIP field counts when its checksum matches the header bytes.

name: is_dir
doc: `processAttributes`: a folder by its DOS attribute or by its name.

name: has_unix_dir_mode
doc: What `fileAdd` makes a folder of besides: an entry written on Unix whose mode says directory.

name: resolve
doc: `utils.resolve`: the name with `.` and `..` segments resolved, which is what keeps an entry from naming a path outside the package.

name: load
doc: `JSZip.loadAsync(bytes)`: the entries in central directory order.

name: read_end_of_central
doc: `readEndOfCentral`: the record count, the directory offset and whether the archive is zip64. It also settles the reader's zero.

name: content_of
doc: What reading the entry gives: `CompressedObject.getContentWorker`. The only check is the length; JSZip does not look at the inflater's status.

name: inflate_as_pako
doc: The bytes pako hands to JSZip for a raw deflate stream. Output leaves in 64 KiB chunks and the last, partial chunk leaves when the stream ends: a stream that is damaged or cut short loses the chunk it was filling. Bytes after the end of the stream are ignored.

name: zip64_with_extensible_data
doc: An archive without entries that JSZip reads as ZIP64, with `extensible` as the extensible data of its ZIP64 end record.

name: load_in_time
doc: `load` on another thread: a reader that never returns must fail the test, not hang the run.

name: read_entries
doc: Reads every entry of a zip container.  An entry is accepted the way JSZip accepts it: the data must inflate to exactly the declared size, and the stored CRC-32 is not checked. A document whose checksum went stale opens in the TypeScript engine, so it opens here.

name: decode_text
doc: The text of an entry as the TypeScript engine reads it in Node (`JSZip.file(name).async('string')`): UTF-8, each ill-formed sequence replaced by U+FFFD the way the WHATWG decoder does, and a leading byte order mark kept as U+FEFF.

name: neutralize_unicode_path_fields
doc: Word resolves parts by the zip header file names and ignores Info-ZIP Unicode Path (0x7075) extra fields; JSZip honours them, so a field with a valid checksum can shadow word/document.xml with another entry's bytes. The field id is blanked in the central directory so the header names win. `None` when there is nothing to do.

name: is_word_part
doc: Parts holding paragraphs whose duplicate style refs get collapsed (last wins).

name: normalize_ooxml_parts
doc: ISO Strict OOXML and non-canonical namespace prefixes are normalized at this single entry point, so the parser's offsets and the save's patches see the same part text. Duplicate style refs of the story parts collapse here too, so every reader sees the winner.

name: load_package
doc: The metered gate, `JSZip.loadAsync` and the declared-size check that runs on the loaded zip. The engines word that check differently, so each passes its own. `Err` is the message of what the TypeScript throws.

name: load_docx_package
doc: `loadDocxZip`: loads a docx resolving part names the way Word does. `Err` is the message of what the TypeScript throws.

name: canonical_prefix
doc: The prefix the engine matches literally for a transitional namespace URI. A binding of one of these URIs to another prefix is renamed: by URI, never by local name alone.

name: measure_attrs
doc: Element local name (w: namespace only) to its measured attributes.

name: has_universal_measures
doc: `hasUniversalMeasures`: a `w:` attribute holding a measure with a unit.

name: needs_ooxml_normalization
doc: Cheap pre-check: `normalize_ooxml_xml` is only worth calling when this is true.

name: lookup
doc: Inner declarations shadow outer ones.

name: has_duplicate_style_refs
doc: `hasDuplicateStyleRefs`: cheap pre-check, `dedupe_style_refs` is only worth calling when this is true.

name: dedupe_style_refs
doc: `dedupeStyleRefs`: repeated `w:pStyle` / `w:rStyle` children of one property set: Word applies the last one, so the earlier siblings are dropped.

name: bytes
doc: `file.async('uint8array')`

name: into_content
doc: Transfers the loaded entry without another inflated-byte allocation.

name: text
doc: `file.async('string')`

name: array_index
doc: The index a JavaScript object orders a key by, when the key is an array index ("0", "17", not "017"): such keys come first, in numeric order.

name: set
doc: `zip.files[name] = part`: a name seen before keeps its place and takes the new content.

name: set_file
doc: `zip.file(name, data)`: the folders above the file are created first where they are missing, as JSZip does by default.

name: add_parent_folders
doc: The folders above `name` that are missing, created outermost first. A loop, not a recursion: a name may hold thousands of slashes.

name: remove
doc: `zip.remove(name)`: a file goes; otherwise `name` (with a trailing slash added where it has none) is a folder prefix, and every entry under it goes, the folder itself included.

name: into_parts
doc: Transfers entries in `Object.keys(zip.files)` order.

name: file
doc: `zip.file(path)`: a folder is not a file.

name: has
doc: `zip.file(path) !== null`

name: text
doc: `await zip.file(path)?.async('string')`

name: bytes
doc: `await zip.file(path)?.async('uint8array')`

name: from_time_value
doc: The date of a time value (milliseconds since 1970 UTC, as `Date` holds it after `TimeClip`); `None` for an invalid date.

name: dos_time_and_date
doc: The DOS time and date JSZip computes with 32-bit operators and writes as the low 16 bits: years outside 1980..2107 wrap, an invalid date is 0.

name: put16
doc: `decToHex(x, 2)`: the low 16 bits.

name: put32
doc: `decToHex(x, 4)`: the low 32 bits.

name: generate
doc: Writes every part of `package`, in its order, stamped with `date` (a time value in milliseconds). JSZip stamps each entry with the clock at the time `zip.file()` added it; here the caller passes the instant.  A part that cannot be read (its content was damaged when it was loaded) is an error: JSZip would fail on it the same way.

name: col_letter
doc: Series data columns start at B (column A holds the categories): 0 → B … 24 → Z, 25 → AA, 26 → AB, … (plain charCode arithmetic breaks past Z).

name: si
doc: `si`: the index of `s` among the shared strings, added at the end when new.

name: chart_workbook_parts
doc: The workbook's parts, by path inside the xlsx package.

name: put
doc: `out.set(bytes, offset)`: a write past the end is a RangeError.

name: set_uint16
doc: `view.setUint16(offset, value, true)`: the value is taken modulo 2^16.

name: set_uint32
doc: `view.setUint32(offset, value, true)`: the value is taken modulo 2^32.

name: stored_zip
doc: A zip of `files`, stored without compression: the chart engines insert charts synchronously, and a chart's workbook is a few hundred bytes.
